```
✓ stepdown-ktu · vet-stop: optional env scrub / no-code-turn skip   [● P4 · CLOSED]
Owner: unknown · Type: task
Created: 2026-07-27 · Updated: 2026-07-30
Labels: dx, hooks
Estimate: 45m
Closed: 2026-07-30 (Implemented opt-in STEPDOWN_VET_SKIP_NO_CODE + STEPDOWN_VET_SCRUB_ENV with unit tests)

Opt-in env for vet-stop: skip bun vet on no-code turns; scrub secret-like env values from followup_message.

Design:
Files: .cursor/hooks/vet-stop.ts, tests/vet-stop.test.ts
Skip detection: git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all; fail-open (run vet) on git errors.
Code paths: src/, tests/, scripts/, .cursor/hooks/, plus root package.json/tsconfig*/.ox*/bunfig.toml.
Scrub: keys matching SECRET|TOKEN|PASSWORD|API_KEY|CREDENTIAL|PRIVATE_KEY|AUTH; min value len 8.
Default unchanged (strict quality gate) unless env opts in.

Acceptance Criteria:
Given STEPDOWN_VET_SKIP_NO_CODE=1 and git porcelain has no paths under src/ tests/ scripts/ .cursor/hooks/ or root configs, when stop status is completed, then vet-stop exits without running bun vet.
Given STEPDOWN_VET_SCRUB_ENV=1 and followup includes a value from a secret-like env key (length>=8), when buildFollowup runs, then that value is replaced with [scrubbed:KEY].
Given neither env is set, when stop completes with code dirt, then behavior matches prior always-run vet gate.

```
